game_title: Boolean Circuit – Ash Rim Trail Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the magma valve.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: In Ash Rim Trail, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the magma valve. Each round, magma slimes strike the magma valve, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the power_on value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the magma valve from magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail: keep the power_on meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: power_on drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 29 seconds while power_on > 0.
